purpose: Bounded optional FedProx screen after repeated FedAvg non-IID rare-class failure; not deployment approval
preconditions: Local tests including mu=0 equivalence and positive-mu recovery pass
Cloud two-round positive-mu and zero-mu pilots pass before any 60-round launch
Record CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 and retain the existing cloud package versions
Fresh same-code FedAvg bridge reproduces historical partition-0 seed-7 metrics before candidates launch
selection: Compare each candidate to the same-code bridge. Eligible candidate with highest validation macro-F1 wins; exact tie uses smaller mu. No gate changes after results.
stop_rule: If neither candidate passes, stop this extension. Confirmation on partitions 1/2 and model seeds 8/9 requires a separate approved plan. No coefficient expansion.
test_policy: Validation only; no test split needed or permitted for tuning
budget: Three full-length runs maximum (one bridge, two candidates), plus bounded two-round correctness pilots. Monitor within one hour; runtime/cost are not guaranteed. User controls cloud launch and stopping.
